steps.title: Pick a base
steps.text: 26 staples at their usual fit, each drawn on a real flat sketch.

steps.title: Add what it needs
steps.text: Pockets, closures and washes: only what suits this base is offered, and each one lands where it usually goes.

steps.title: Pick the colours
steps.text: A colour system: the first colour is the garment, and every colour in it becomes a colourway.

steps.title: Open it in the Studio
steps.text: The piece arrives measured, drawn and coloured, ready to finish.

steps.title: Real flats, checked as you go
steps.text: The flats are measured in inches, and every pocket, placement and detail is checked against what a factory can make.

steps.title: The pattern drafts itself
steps.text: From the flats, graded XS to XXL. Every seam is walked against the one it is sewn to.

steps.title: Every piece, ready to cut
steps.text: The pattern pieces, apart, with seam allowances and notches, and laid out on the cloth with its yardage.

steps.title: A tech pack the factory signs off
steps.text: Every detail is a callout pinned on the flat, with a note to the factory, and the factory acknowledges each one.

steps.title: Measured, graded, placed
steps.text: The spec sheet: every placement measured from the shoulder and the centre front, and every point of measure graded XS to XXL.
